guideWhichBank: Which bank is the statement from?
guideStep1: Open the {bank} app or net banking website and log in.
guideStep2: Find "Account statement" (usually under Accounts or Services).
guideStep3: Choose the months you want, for example the last 3 months.
guideStep4: Download it as PDF or Excel, then upload that file here.
guidePasswordTitle: If the file asks for a password
guidePassword_sbi: Usually the last 5 digits of your registered mobile number, then your date of birth as DDMMYY. Example: 12345 and 11 Feb 1990 make 12345110290.
guidePassword_hdfc: Your numeric Customer ID (the number you use to log in to HDFC net banking).
guidePassword_icici: Usually the first 4 letters of your name, then your birth day and month as DDMM. Example: RAHU1503 for Rahul, born 15 March. Try capitals and small letters.
guidePassword_axis: Usually the first 4 letters of your name in capitals, then your birth day and month as DDMM. Example: RAHU1508.
guidePassword_kotak: Usually your CRN (Customer Relationship Number). Text "CRN" from your registered mobile to 5676788 to get it.
guidePassword_pnb: It differs between accounts: try your date of birth as DDMMYYYY, then your full account number.
guidePassword_other: Banks usually use your customer ID, account number, date of birth, or a mix of your name and date of birth.
guideCheckEmail: The email or SMS that came with your statement says exactly which password it uses. That is always the surest answer. The password is only used once to open the file; Horizon does not keep it.
metaDescription: Connect a bank through Plaid or Setu, or upload a statement from your bank.
title: Connect a bank
subtext: There are three ways: a US bank through Plaid, an Indian bank through RBI's secure bank link (Account Aggregator), or a statement file from your net banking.
plaidDescription: Checking and savings accounts at US banks. You sign in to your bank to connect it. This is test mode, so pick any bank and use the test login.
setuDescription: Indian bank accounts through RBI's secure bank link. You approve sharing with your mobile number, then come back here.
fileDescription: Upload a statement file from your net banking. Horizon reads the columns for you, and you check them before anything is saved.
cbSubtext: The result of your approval on the Account Aggregator.
cbPending: Your approval is still waiting. Finish approving on the Account Aggregator, then try again.
cbRejected: The request was declined, so no accounts were connected.
cbMissing: We could not find the connection you started. Please start again.
cbError: Something went wrong while finishing the connection: {error}
cbOther: The approval status is {status}. No accounts were connected.
